  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `invoke_stall_judge` escalation-keep chain (lines 23037-23056) — the case "linked PR merged into a target base AND not recognized as the issue's implementation PR".

The judge then re-runs every tick until the `MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY` backstop (23004-23006) forces escalation. No test covers this shape. The agents.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md:2 wording claims coverage this case does not have; the changelog.d wording hedges it.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
